text.p: 360 Communications Co and BellSouth Corp said Monday they will combine ownership stakes in two cellular partnerships and transfer their interests in two other markets.

The partners said they will combine their interests in two partnerships that control celllar licenses in central Florida and Richmond, Va. Additionally, 360 will contribute its 20-percent stake in a rural service area in Georgia along with an undisclosed amount of cash.
Separately, BellSouth will buy 360's cellular systems in Dothan, Ala., while 360 will acquire BellSouth's 10-percent stake in the system that serves Tallahassee, Fla.
All of the proposed moves require regulatory approval.
360 provides wireless voice and data services in 16 states. Its shares were unchanged Monday at 21-3/4.
